provenance.recallRules: Within the same conversation, earlier segments for the exact current request only; bounded user turns/answer intent as untrusted discussion, reauthorize and reread every current fact, never reuse old factual authority/refs/previews/consent. No cross-request material. New conversation clears recall. Current guides revalidated.

lifecycle.pagehide: best-effort authenticated keepalive close of current known owned conversation only; crash may not fire; no unknown cleanup or TTL bypass; accepted confirm completes or reconciles through durable owned receipt
lifecycle.processCap: 100 live conversations; evict oldest by last human activity, creation time and ID when no pending turn or confirm; victim reads conversation_expired; all in-flight refuses admission service_unavailable; at most1000 compact tombstones with bounded idempotency mappings
lifecycle.confirmCloseOrder: confirm pins synchronously after owned preview lookup and origin validation; later close cannot discard its preview; close first rejects a new confirm; durable applied receipts remain account-owned
lifecycle.contextResolution: model-free context POST; same generation+same context returns same origin; older generation rejected; foreign/deleted generic404
lifecycle.generation: server authorizes route24hex; tool registry uses opaque refs; a counter never authorizes records
lifecycle.expiry: clear transcript and unused action tokens; visible expiry notice and explicit New conversation; pending confirms remain account-owned until auth loss
lifecycle.turnCap: hard20 accepted unique turns; idempotent replay not counted; explicit New conversation closes old memory slot
lifecycle.memoryCap: server evicts oldest whole inactive segments; TurnView.trimmedSegmentIds tells client exact removals; active-segment overflow transcript_limit
lifecycle.discard: idempotent own-profile; works after context change/expiry; applied receipt never undone
lifecycle.unknownOutcome: client-derived only; GET owned policy-change status; never automatic confirm retry
lifecycle.evidence: exact owned immutable snapshot or404/409; article summary/verified customer facts only; no raw document dump
lifecycle.contextKind: account iff requestContextId null, otherwise request
lifecycle.cancellation: body clientActionId only; original generation ignored after navigation; late previews discarded unless already confirmed

transport.rawTokenDelivery: transient original turn only; no restore after full reload

interpretation.online: model interprets meaning and proposes only allowlisted tool calls; no directIntent/assertPreviewIntent phrase veto online
interpretation.offline: existing phrase-filter and deterministic records, explicitly labelled
interpretation.proposal: server-bound latest human turn and current authorized context; schema/field/value/permission/fresh-state checks; proposal is never approval
interpretation.fromValue: asserted current default quota is validated against fresh saved policy; mismatch returns current_value_differs with canonical saved-value facts and no preview
interpretation.noChange: target already saved returns no_change_needed and no preview or Confirm
interpretation.invalidModel: reject invalid online proposal; do not convert to a hidden phrase-filter write
interpretation.unavailableModel: honest offline fallback may use existing phrase filter with unchanged fresh preview/human confirmation
interpretation.modeAuthority: backend configuration/capabilities only, never client/model flags

narration.validation: backend and client enforce one explanation at most and first position; JSON schema validates each block shape
narration.sourceCopy: Iris chose what to show (AI); figures come straight from your records
narration.fallbackSource: offline_stub and deterministic_records retain existing honest labels
narration.references: current authorized turn facts only; evidence refs derived by backend; plain text only; no HTML/URLs/controls
narration.authority: canonical tables, values, preview, human Confirm, verified receipt and audit remain authoritative; generated prose never approves or executes
narration.invalidExplanation: canonical blocks plus explanation_unavailable notice, no explanation
narration.polling: byte-stable retained recipe, no new completion on poll
narration.semanticLimit: schema and citations do not guarantee semantic truth; adversarial and separately authorized live evaluation required
narration.budget: reuse final selection completion; existing call/function/time/token/memory/cost bounds unchanged
